name: Library Community Volunteer (14 and up)
what_you_do: Do a variety of tasks around the library. Jobs are given out as they are needed, and training is provided.
who_can_apply: You must be 14 or older. If you are under 18, a parent or guardian must say yes.
duration: The page does not state a time commitment
deadline_text: No deadline is listed as of Nov 3, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the volunteer application on the page, or pick one up at any library information desk. Questions: 626-307-1269.
notes: This page is for all volunteers, not only teens. The library is at 318 S. Ramona Avenue.
